name: py-linkedin-jobs-scraper
what_it_holds: Python/headless-browser library scraping public LinkedIn job listings: job id, title, company, location, links, salary/benefits, easy-apply flag, applicant counts, employment type and experience-level filters, geoId-based geographic filtering, adaptive rate limiting, session persistence, CLI + programmatic API, JSON/CSV/table output. MIT, 189 commits.
why_useful: Could be pointed at Airbnb's LinkedIn job listings to build an open-roles count and mix (function, seniority, geography) over time as a hiring-pace/headcount-growth proxy — same use case as JobSpy but LinkedIn-specific with richer per-posting metadata (applicant counts). Method only, current-snapshot, ToS caveats apply; not run.

what_it_holds: ML notebook predicting daily STR rental rates using downloads from AllTheRooms.com (a subscription STR data vendor named explicitly in gap #2). Source CSVs are NOT committed ('I did not upload the source data' due to AllTheRooms redistribution restrictions); only a trained pickle model and notebook are present. Scope is a single zip code chosen by the author.
why_useful: Confirms AllTheRooms.com as a named, real vendor for realized STR rates (relevant to gap #2), and shows what fields/approach a downloaded AllTheRooms export contains, even though no data is redistributable here.
